lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Signal No. 2! Biglang bumuhos ang malakas na ulan paglabas mo ng klase. Hanggang bukong-bukong na ang baha sa España at halos walang dumadaan na jeep.
lines.textEn: Typhoon Signal No. 2! Torrential monsoon rain hits right after dismissal. Ankle-deep floodwater pools along the street and jeepneys are packed solid.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: {name}, stranded tayo! ₱150 ang singil ng pedicab patawid sa baha, pero pwede rin tayong makisilong muna sa waiting shed habang hinihintay humupa.
lines.textEn: {name}, we are stranded! The pedicab driver is asking ₱150 to cross the flood, or we can wait it out under the shed roof.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Basa na ang bag ko — kailangan kong ingatan ang mga notes at phone ko!
lines.textEn: My bag is already soaked — I have to protect my notebooks and phone!

choices.text: Mag-hati sa pedicab kasama si Miggy (₱80 each) para makauwi nang tuyo.
choices.textEn: Split the pedicab fare with Miggy (₱80 each) to get home dry.

choices.text: Ibalot sa plastic ang sapatos at lumusong nang maingat kasama si Miggy.
choices.textEn: Wrap your shoes in plastic bags and wade carefully with Miggy.

choices.text: Maghintay sa carinderia, uminom ng mainit na sabaw (₱45), at mag-review.
choices.textEn: Take shelter at a carinderia with hot soup (₱45) and review notes.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alas-nwebe ng gabi, dalawang oras bago ang online submission deadline — CLICK! Biglang namatay ang ilaw at electric fan. Brownout sa buong barangay!
lines.textEn: 9 PM, two hours before an online submission deadline — CLICK! The lights and fan die instantly. Neighborhood-wide brownout!

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Naku po, 18% na lang ang battery ng phone ko at walang Wi-Fi! Paano ko ipapasa 'tong requirement sa {course}?!
lines.textEn: Oh no, my phone is at 18% and the Wi-Fi router is dead! How do I submit this {course} requirement?!

choices.text: Tumakbo sa 24-hour comshop sa kabilang kanto na may generator (₱100).
choices.textEn: Sprint to the 24-hour computer shop with a generator (₱100).

choices.text: Gumamit ng kandila at ₱20 mobile data hotspot para maipasa on time!
choices.textEn: Light a candle and load ₱20 mobile data to submit right on time!

choices.text: Mag-message nang maayos kay Prof. Reyes at humingi ng 12-hour extension.
choices.textEn: Send a polite photo of the blackout notice to Prof. Reyes for an extension.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Gabi bago ang group presentation. Seen-zone pa rin sa group chat ang isa ninyong kaklase na naka-assign sa pinakamalaking part ng slides.
lines.textEn: Night before the group presentation. One groupmate assigned to half the slides has left the group chat on 'Seen' for three days.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: {name}, nag-story siya sa social media na nasa milk tea shop pero zero pa rin ang ambag niya sa Google Docs! Anong gagawin natin?
lines.textEn: {name}, they just posted an Instagram story at a milk tea shop while their section in our document is completely blank! What do we do?

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Classic 'ambag ko prayers' na naman. Kailangan nating magdesisyon nang matalino.
lines.textEn: Classic 'my contribution is prayers' all over again. We need to handle this smartly.

choices.text: Buhatin na lang kasama si Bea at isama sa peer evaluation ang totoong ambag.
choices.textEn: Carry the project with Bea and write an honest peer evaluation.

choices.text: I-confront nang mahinahon at bigyan ng 2-hour final deadline o tanggal sa list.
choices.textEn: Confront them calmly with a firm 2-hour deadline or removal from the cover page.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: SCREECH! Biglang nagpreno ang jeepney sa traffic! Dumulas ang phone mo mula sa bulsa at bumagsak sa metal floor — may malaking bitak sa screen pero gumagana pa ang touch.
lines.textEn: SCREECH! The jeepney slams its brakes in rush-hour traffic! Your phone slips from your pocket onto the metal floor — spiderweb crack across the screen, though touch still works.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Aray! Nandoon lahat ng PDF reviewers, GCash, at schedule ko! ₱550 ang palit ng LCD sa repair stall...
lines.textEn: Ouch! All my PDF reviewers, e-wallet, and schedules are on this phone! The repair kiosk charges ₱550 for a replacement screen...

choices.text: Ipaayos agad sa Greenhills/mall kiosk (₱550) para hindi masira ang touch.
choices.textEn: Repair the screen right away (₱550) before it dies completely.

choices.text: Lagyan muna ng ₱40 tempered glass tape at mag-raket sa Jeepney Fare Pass!
choices.textEn: Seal it with a ₱40 protector for now and earn cash via Jeepney Fare Pass!

choices.text: Tiisin muna ang cracked screen — basta nababasa pa ang reviewers, laban!
choices.textEn: Live with the spiderweb crack for now — if it displays reviewers, it works!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Nag-trending sa campus freedom wall ang homemade graham balls at iced coffee na tinitinda ninyo sa labas ng gate!
lines.textEn: The homemade graham balls and budget iced coffee you sell outside the gate just went viral on the campus freedom wall!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: {name}! 40 orders agad sa inbox natin! Kung mag-o-overtime tayong mag-pack ngayong gabi, malaking kita 'to!
lines.textEn: {name}! We already have 40 pre-orders in our inbox! If we hustle and pack tonight, this will be a huge payday!

choices.text: I-grab ang momentum! Mag-sell sa Tusok-Tusok / Side Hustle minigame!
choices.textEn: Ride the viral wave and run a live Side Hustle shift!

choices.text: Tanggapin ang 20 orders lang para may oras pa sa aral at pahinga.
choices.textEn: Cap it at 20 orders so you still have time to study and sleep.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Nagkukumpulan ang mga estudyante sa bulletin board ng college building. Nakita mo ang pangalan mo — nakapaskil sa Honor Roll & Dean's List candidates!
lines.textEn: Students crowd around the department bulletin board. Near the top of the printed sheet, you spot your own name on the Dean's List honor roll!

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Deserve mo 'yan, {name}. Alam ng faculty kung gaano ka kasipag. May ₱500 book stipend ang honor roll nominees ngayong buwan.
lines.textEn: Well deserved, {name}. The faculty sees how hard you work. Honor roll nominees receive a ₱500 book stipend this month.

choices.text: Tanggapin nang buong pasasalamat at ibalita agad kina Mama at Tatay!
choices.textEn: Accept gratefully and call Mama and Tatay right away!

choices.text: I-share ang book stipend sa study group ninyo ni Bea para mas marami ang pumasa!
choices.textEn: Use part of the stipend to print shared reviewers for Bea's study group!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Gabi na at ₱35 na lang ang barya sa bulsa mo. Nag-order ka ng isang tasang kanin at libreng sabaw sa carinderia ni Aling Nena.
lines.textEn: It is late evening and only ₱35 in coins jingle in your pocket. You quietly order one cup of rice and free soup at Aling Nena's carinderia.

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: Huy {name}, huwag mo akong lokohin — nakikita ko sa mata mo na hindi ka pa nagtatanghalian. Eto, may dalawang pirasong adobo at itlog sa ilalim ng kanin mo. Libre na 'yan sa masipag na bata.
lines.textEn: Don't fool me, {name} — I can tell you skipped lunch too. Look under your rice: two pieces of adobo and a boiled egg. On the house for a hardworking kid.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Aling Nena... babayaran ko po kayo pag naka-graduate ako, pramis!
lines.textEn: Aling Nena... I promise I will repay your kindness the day I graduate!

choices.text: Tumulong maghugas ng pinggan pagkatapos kumain bilang pasasalamat.
choices.textEn: Stay 30 minutes to help wash dishes as a heartfelt thank-you.

choices.text: Mag-volunteer sa rush hour ng carinderia bukas para kumita rin!
choices.textEn: Offer to cover the lunch rush right now to earn extra cash!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alas-onse ng gabi, umuulan nang mahina sa labas. Nagluto kayo ng tatlong pack ng spicy pancit canton at nilagang itlog sa maliit na rice cooker.
lines.textEn: 11 PM, gentle tropical rain tapping the window. You cook three packs of spicy pancit canton with boiled eggs in a tiny dorm rice cooker.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Alam mo {name}, nakakatawa no — ang hirap ng buhay estudyante, pero kapag ganito tayong sabay-sabay kumakain, parang kaya natin lahat.
lines.textEn: You know {name}, it is funny — student life is exhausting, yet moments like sharing noodles together make everything feel survivable.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Basta walang uubos ng kalamansi flavor! Cheers sa mga puyat pero hindi sumusuko!
lines.textEn: Just nobody hog the calamansi flavor! Cheers to the sleep-deprived who never quit!

choices.text: Magkwentuhan tungkol sa mga pangarap ninyo 5 years from now.
choices.textEn: Stay up talking about where you all dream of being 5 years from now.

choices.text: Sabay-sabay mag-flashcards habang kumakain para productive pa rin!
choices.textEn: Quiz each other with flashcards between bites so the night stays productive!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: May nag-message na maliit na lokal na negosyo sa campus board: naghahanap ng student freelancer para mag-ayos ng poster layout at inventory sheet sa loob ng isang gabi.
lines.textEn: A neighborhood small business posts an urgent gig on the campus board: looking for a student freelancer to fix a flyer layout and inventory sheet overnight.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: Uy {name}, nirekomenda kita! Malaki ang bayad nito kung matatapos mo agad.
lines.textEn: Hey {name}, I recommended you! Pay is solid if you can knock it out fast.

choices.text: Tanggapin ang gig at tapusin nang malinis! (+₱550, -14 EN)
choices.textEn: Take the overnight gig and deliver clean work! (+₱550, -14 EN)

choices.text: Subukan ang live Freelance Task challenge para mas malaki ang kita!
choices.textEn: Launch the live Freelance Task minigame for performance pay!

choices.text: Mag-pass muna at ibigay sa kaklaseng mas nangangailangan.
choices.textEn: Pass the gig along to a classmate who needs rent money more right now.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Pista sa {hometown}! Makukulay ang banderitas sa plaza, umuusok ang mga inihaw na barbecue, at rinig ang tugtog ng marching band mula sa kalsada.
lines.textEn: Barangay fiesta in {hometown}! Colorful paper banderitas flutter over the plaza, smoky barbecue grills sizzle, and a brass band echoes down the street.

lines.speaker: Tatay
lines.text: Uwi ka muna kahit isang gabi, {name}! Minsan lang sa isang taon ang pista — nagluto si Mama mo ng paborito mong caldereta.
lines.textEn: Come home for one night, {name}! Fiesta only comes once a year — your Mama cooked your favorite caldereta.

choices.text: Umuwi at makisaya kasama ang pamilya at mga kapitbahay!
choices.textEn: Spend the fiesta evening laughing and eating with family and neighbors!

choices.text: Tumulong magbenta ng malamig na buko juice sa plaza habang nakikifiesta!
choices.textEn: Help sell chilled buko juice at the fiesta plaza to earn extra baon!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Sa ilalim ng study table sa library, may napulot kang brown na pitaka. Pagtingin mo sa ID, may lamang ₱1,500 at tuition receipt ng isang freshman student!
lines.textEn: Under a library study table, you find a worn brown wallet. Inside are a freshman ID, ₱1,500 in neatly folded bills, and a tuition assessment slip!

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Naku, pambayad ng tuition niya 'to! Malamang umiiyak na siya kakahanap ngayon.
lines.textEn: Oh no, that is their tuition money! They must be panicking looking for this right now.

choices.text: I-surrender agad sa Student Affairs at hanapin ang freshman para personal na isauli.
choices.textEn: Turn it in immediately and personally return it to the relieved freshman.

journal.title: Nagsauli ng Tuition Wallet
journal.summary: Kahit gipit ka, pinili mong isauli ang napulot na ₱1,500 tuition ng isang freshman.
journal.summaryEn: Even while broke, you returned a lost ₱1,500 tuition wallet to a freshman.

choices.text: Isauli agad at tanggapin ang ₱150 na kusa niyang binigay na pasasalamat.
choices.textEn: Return every peso and graciously accept the ₱150 merienda thank-you they insist on.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rush hour sa jeep. Nag-aabot ka ng bayad nang mapansin mong kulang ng ₱15 ang pamasahe ng matandang lola sa tabi mo na pauwi galing check-up.
lines.textEn: Rush hour on the jeepney. Passing fares forward, you notice an elderly grandmother next to you is ₱15 short after coming from a clinic check-up.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Manong driver, sagot ko na po ang bayad ni Lola — isang estudyante at isang senior po, barya lang.
lines.textEn: Driver, I have got Lola's fare covered — one student and one senior, exact coins.

choices.text: Sagutin ang pamasahe ni Lola at tulungan siyang bumaba nang maingat.
choices.textEn: Cover Lola's fare and help her step down safely at her stop.

choices.text: Tulungan ding mag-abot ng sukli sa buong jeepney ride!
choices.textEn: Help Manong pass exact change through the packed jeepney!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Biglang umulan pagkatapos ng late afternoon class. Nakatayo si Jamie sa gate nang walang payong — buti na lang dala mo ang maliit mong folding umbrella.
lines.textEn: A sudden downpour catches students at the gate after late afternoon class. Jamie stands without an umbrella — luckily you brought your small folding one.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Hala {name}, maliit 'yang payong mo, mababasa ang balikat mo kung maghahati tayo!
lines.textEn: Whoa {name}, your umbrella is tiny, your shoulder will get soaked if we share!

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Okay lang, sanay na sa ulan. Hatid na kita hanggang sakayan ng jeep.
lines.textEn: I don't mind a little rain. Let me walk you to the jeepney stop.

choices.text: Itagilid ang payong papunta kay Jamie at magkwentuhan habang naglalakad.
choices.textEn: Tilt the umbrella over Jamie and share stories all the way to the stop.

journal.title: Isang Payong Sa Ulan
journal.summary: Hinatid mo si Jamie sa sakayan sa gitna ng malakas na ulan — core memory unlocked.
journal.summaryEn: Walked Jamie to the jeepney stop under one small umbrella — core memory unlocked.

choices.text: Sumilong muna sa bakery at maghati sa tig-₱30 na mainit na ensaymada!
choices.textEn: Duck into the corner bakery and split a warm ₱30 ensaymada together!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Sabado ng hapon sa library. May inabot si Jamie na maliit na sticky note sa ibabaw ng notebook mo: 'Kaya mo 'yan, future {course} graduate! — J.'
lines.textEn: Saturday afternoon in the quiet library. Jamie slides a tiny sticky note onto your notebook: 'You got this, future {course} graduate! — J.'

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Sorry kung corny, {name}... gusto ko lang malaman mo na bilib na bilib ako sa sipag mo. Sabay tayong mag-review lagi ha?
lines.textEn: Sorry if it is cheesy, {name}... I just want you to know how much I admire your grit. Can we keep being study partners?

choices.text: Itago ang sticky note sa ID lace mo: 'Best study partner sa buong campus.'
choices.textEn: Tuck the sticky note behind your student ID: 'Best study partner on campus.'

choices.text: Mag-set ng deal: kung pareho tayong makapasa nang mataas, mag-fiesta date tayo!
choices.textEn: Make a deal: if we both ace this sem, we celebrate at the plaza fiesta!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Friday acoustic night sa isang student café! Nakasampa si Miggy sa maliit na stage hawak ang lumang gitara niya, tumutugtog ng classic OPM songs.
lines.textEn: Friday acoustic night at a student café! Miggy climbs the tiny corner stage with his worn acoustic guitar, strumming classic OPM anthems.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Pre {name}! Kailangan ko ng taga-bantay ng tip jar at taga-kanta sa chorus! Hati tayo sa tips mamaya!
lines.textEn: Bro {name}! Help me watch the tip jar and back me up on the chorus! We split the tips tonight!

choices.text: Sumampa sa stage at maki-jam sa chorus ng OPM classics!
choices.textEn: Hop on stage and belt out the OPM chorus with the crowd!

choices.text: Mag-cheer mula sa harap at tulungan siyang mag-promote ng gig online.
choices.textEn: Cheer loudly from the front table and hype his set to classmates.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Crisis sa student org room! Bukas ang liquidation report sa OSA, pero hindi nagtutugma ng ₱450 ang mga resibo ng Foundation Week booth.
lines.textEn: Crisis in the student org room! Liquidation is due to Student Affairs tomorrow, yet receipts are off by ₱450.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: {name}, nalilito na ako sa mga resibo ng yelo, tarpaulin, at tape! Baka ma-suspend ang org recognition natin kung mali ang audit!
lines.textEn: {name}, I am drowning in ice, tarpaulin, and tape receipts! Our org could lose accreditation if the audit fails!

choices.text: Umupo kasama si Carlo, i-audit isa-isa ang resibo, at hanapin ang nawawalang ₱450!
choices.textEn: Sit down with Carlo and reconcile every single receipt line by line!

choices.text: Mag-set up ng clean spreadsheet template para transparent na ang org forever.
choices.textEn: Build a clean digital ledger template so the org stays transparent forever.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Tahimik na gabi sa beranda. Nakaupo si Tatay habang umiinom ng mainit na kape at nakatanaw sa buwan.
lines.textEn: Quiet evening on the porch. Tatay sits sipping hot coffee while looking up at the moon.

lines.speaker: Tatay
lines.text: Alam mo {name}, hindi man kami nakapagtapos ng college ng Mama mo, bawat araw na nakikita ka naming nagsusumikap sa {course}, parang kami na rin ang gumagraduate.
lines.textEn: You know {name}, even though your Mama and I never finished college, every day we watch you push through {course}, it feels like we are graduating right alongside you.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Tay, kapag nakatapos ako, kayo naman ang magpapahinga. Pangako ko 'yan.
lines.textEn: Tay, the day I graduate, it will be your turn to rest. I promise.

choices.text: Tabihan si Tatay, kwentuhan siya ng mga natutunan mo sa school.
choices.textEn: Sit beside Tatay and share stories of everything you learned this term.

choices.text: Mag-abot ng ₱200 mula sa raket mo pambili ng vitamins nina Mama at Tatay.
choices.textEn: Slip ₱200 from your side-hustle earnings for Mama and Tatay's vitamins.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Tinawag ka ni Prof. Reyes sa faculty cubicle pagkatapos ng klase. Akala mo may mali sa papel mo — pero nakangiti siya.
lines.textEn: Prof. Reyes calls you into the faculty cubicle after lecture. You brace for bad news — yet he is smiling warmly.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Working student din ako noon, {name}. Minsan nilalakad ko lang mula Taft hanggang Recto para makatipid ng pamasahe. Eto, hiramin mo 'tong reference book ko para sa {course} — huwag ka nang bumili.
lines.textEn: I was a working student once too, {name}. I used to walk from Taft to Recto just to save jeepney fare. Borrow my reference book for {course} — don't waste money buying one.

choices.text: Tanggapin ang libro at humingi ng tips kung paano mag-excel sa {course}!
choices.textEn: Gratefully borrow the textbook and ask for study strategies in {course}!

choices.text: Mag-alok na tumulong sa pag-encode ng lecture handouts ni Sir bilang kapalit.
choices.textEn: Offer to help digitize Sir's lecture notes in exchange.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Sabado ng umaga, nakasimangot si Aling Nena sa harap ng makapal niyang listahan ng utang at stock ng tindahan.
lines.textEn: Saturday morning, Aling Nena frowns over a thick notebook of store inventory and neighbor IOUs.

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: {name}, ikaw ang magaling sa kwenta! Pa-check naman ng inventory ko — mukhang nalulugi ako sa presyo ng kape at delata.
lines.textEn: {name}, you have a sharp head for numbers! Help me audit my stock pricing — I think inflation is eating my margins.

choices.text: Ayusin ang pricing at utang tracker ni Aling Nena sa malinis na notebook!
choices.textEn: Reorganize Aling Nena's profit margins and ledger cleanly!

choices.text: Tumulong muna sa lunch rush sa carinderia niya pagkatapos mag-audit!
choices.textEn: Help audit the ledger and jump into her lunch rush shift!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 'Get 1/4 sheet of pad paper!' — ang limang salitang nagpapatigil ng tibok ng puso ng bawat estudyanteng Pilipino.
lines.textEn: 'Get a 1/4 sheet of pad paper!' — the seven words that instantly stop every Filipino student's heartbeat.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Surprise 20-item quiz sa lecture last week! Walang maghihiraman ng papel — este, sige magbigayan na pero tahimik!
lines.textEn: Surprise 20-item quiz on last week's lecture! No borrowing paper — alright, share quietly, clock starts now!

choices.text: Subukan ang live Tutoring Quiz brain-warm-up para ma-ace ang surprise quiz!
choices.textEn: Lock in and test your recall in the Tutoring Quiz challenge!

choices.text: Mag-share ng 1/4 pad paper sa buong row at mag-focus nang tahimik.
choices.textEn: Hand out 1/4 sheets to your whole row and focus calmly on every item.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Bihirang Linggo ng umaga na walang exam bukas at walang pending shift. Presko ang hangin, malinis ang nilabhang uniform, at may ₱60 extra ka sa bulsa.
lines.textEn: A rare Sunday morning with no exam tomorrow and no shift on the clock. Cool breeze, freshly washed uniform drying on the line, and ₱60 spare change.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Hinga muna. Hindi naman masama magpahinga paminsan-minsan para mas malakas ulit sa Lunes.
lines.textEn: Time to breathe. Taking one gentle morning to recharge makes Monday twice as conquerable.

choices.text: Bumili ng mainit na taho at pandesal (₱40) at maglakad-lakad habang nakikinig ng music.
choices.textEn: Grab warm taho and pandesal (₱40) and take a relaxing morning walk.

choices.text: Mag-advance reading ng 2 chapters habang presko pa ang umaga.
choices.textEn: Do calm advance reading for two chapters while the morning is peaceful.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Pagdating sa canteen, napalunok ka sa bagong price board: tumaas ng ₱15 ang bawat silog at ₱10 ang kanin dahil sa inflation!
lines.textEn: Stepping into the canteen, your jaw drops at the updated menu board: silog meals just jumped by ₱15 and extra rice went up ₱10!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Grabe na talaga ang bilihin ngayon, {name}! Parang kailan lang ₱55 lang ang tapsilog, ngayon ₱85 na!
lines.textEn: Prices are wild right now, {name}! Felt like tapsilog was ₱55 yesterday, now it is ₱85!

choices.text: Mag-meal prep ng adobo at itlog sa boarding house para makatipid buong linggo!
choices.textEn: Switch to batch-cooked adobo and boiled eggs to beat inflation all week!

choices.text: Maghati kayo ni Miggy sa ulam at mag-extra kanin na lang (₱45 each).
choices.textEn: Split one full ulam order with Miggy and share extra rice (₱45 each).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Holiday weekend! Nag-text ang shift manager ng malapit na fastfood branch: nagkulang sila ng crew at nag-aalok ng holiday premium pay!
lines.textEn: Holiday weekend! The nearby fastfood shift manager texts you: they are short-staffed and offering holiday premium pay!

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: {name}, kung kaya mong mag-cover ng 1-hour rush shift ngayon, may +₱200 holiday bonus on top ng regular pay mo!
lines.textEn: {name}, if you can cover one rush shift today, there is a +₱200 holiday bonus on top of your shift pay!

choices.text: Kunin ang holiday shift! (Play Fastfood Crew +₱200 bonus)
choices.textEn: Take the holiday shift! (Play Fastfood Crew +₱200 bonus)

choices.text: Magpahinga na lang muna — kailangan ng katawan ko ang holiday rest.
choices.textEn: Politely decline and use the holiday to fully recover your energy.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Hapon sa footbridge habang kumakagat ang kulay kahel na sunset sa Manila skyline. Tanaw mo ang mga jeepney, estudyante, at mga manggagawang pauwi.
lines.textEn: Late afternoon on the pedestrian overpass as orange sunset washes over the Manila skyline. Below you, jeepneys, students, and workers stream homeward.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Ang dami pala naming lumalaban araw-araw. Nakakapagod, oo... pero habang may pangarap ako para sa pamilya ko sa {hometown}, hindi ako hihinto.
lines.textEn: So many of us are fighting the same quiet battle every single day. It is exhausting, sure... yet as long as I carry my dream for {hometown}, I am not stopping.

choices.text: Isulat sa journal ang pangako mo sa sarili mo at magpatuloy nang mas matatag!
choices.textEn: Write a promise to your future self in your journal and keep pushing!

journal.title: Sunset Sa Footbridge
journal.summary: Sandali kang huminto para huminga at maalala kung para kanino ang bawat pagod mo.
journal.summaryEn: Paused on the overpass at sunset to remember who you are fighting for.

choices.text: Mag-review ng notes habang nakatayo sa overpass — tuloy ang grind!
choices.textEn: Review your flash notes right there in the golden light — keep grinding!
